We need to determine which charges from the lexicon apply to the facts.

Facts: In 1998, defendant Pan transferred a piece of residential land (宅基地) to Li for 7000 yuan, Li got land use certificate, etc. In 2011, Pan, using concealment, transferred the same land again to victim Su, fraudulently obtaining 30,000 yuan. Su discovered fraud, reported, they confessed. Pan was detained for suspected fraud. He later repaid 30,000. Victim forgave. Also Pan had prior conviction for illegal acquisition and illegal logging? Actually "原犯非法收购盗伐、滥伐的林木罪的××考验期". That indicates he previously had a conviction for illegal acquisition, illegal logging, etc. But that is not part of current case.

So charges: The act is fraudulent sale of land (宅基地) that had already been transferred. This is fraud (诈骗) or contract fraud (合同诈骗). The lexicon includes "合同诈骗" and "诈骗". Which is appropriate? The fact: He concealed the fact that the land had already been transferred, and obtained money. That's contract fraud (fraud in the performance of a contract). The lexicon includes "合同诈骗". Also "诈骗" is generic. Which one to choose? The example earlier: For a case of extortion (敲诈勒索) they used "敲诈勒索" which is not in lexicon but they used "敲诈勒索"? Actually lexicon didn't have that; they used "敲诈勒索" as answer. So they can use names not in lexicon if needed. But instruction says: "If no listed name fits, use the correct statutory name anyway." So we can use "合同诈骗" if that fits. The fact is about fraud in a contract for land transfer. So "合同诈骗" is appropriate.

Also there is illegal transfer of land use rights: "非法转让、倒卖土地使用权". The lexicon includes that. The act of transferring land use rights illegally is a crime. He transferred land that he didn't have rights to. So that charge also applies. The fact includes that he transferred the land to Li (maybe legal?), but then transferred again illegally. The illegal transfer is indeed "非法转让、倒卖土地使用权". So we have two charges: "非法转让、倒卖土地使用权" and "合同诈骗" (or "诈骗").

Which one is more appropriate? The fact includes both the illegal transfer and the fraud. The illegal transfer is a separate crime. So we should list both.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法转让、倒卖土地使用权;合同诈骗<eoa>
